主要内容: BHR and AVIC Auto have completed the acquisition of Henniges Automotive, a leading designer and manufacturer of sealing and anti-vibration solutions for high-end automobiles. The transaction, valued at around US$600 million, is structured as a joint acquisition with BHR holding 49% and AVIC Auto 51%. This acquisition is expected to enhance Henniges' growth potential through the combined industrial expertise, marketing, and financial resources of both partners. BHR, a Sino-U.S. investment firm, has a history of cross-border investments and is focused on technologically innovative and financially robust overseas targets in sectors such as high-end manufacturing, healthcare, financial services, and environmental technology.
